title: History of “{{name}}”
intro_one: Every change from the last {{count}} day, with who made it.
intro_other: Every change from the last {{count}} days, with who made it.
empty_one: No changes in the last {{count}} day.
empty_other: No changes in the last {{count}} days.
loadFailed: What changed couldn’t be loaded. Try again.
movedTo: Its place was gone, so it went to {{place}}

page.title: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> renamed it from “{{before}}” to “{{after}}”
page.movedTop: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> moved it to the top of the project
page.restored: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> brought it back from the trash

card.title: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> renamed it from “{{before}}” to “{{after}}”
card.unarchived: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> took it out of the archive
card.restored: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> brought it back from the trash
card.unlinked: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> removed its link to the page “{{page}}”

checklist.title: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> renamed the checklist “{{before}}” to “{{after}}”
checklist.deleted: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> moved the checklist “{{title}}” to the trash

item.deleted: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> moved the item “{{text}}” to the trash

attachment.deleted: <actor>{{actor}}</actor> moved the file “{{name}}” to the trash
